sampling: Select the eight smallest SHA256(prefix + address) values among the 500 candidate-day sources; no replacement after failures or inspection of histories.
cutoff: Include confirmed transactions only at block_height strictly below the source's known collector-payment block; exclude the entire payment block, regardless of block timestamps.
target: Descriptive pre-payment source-address feature pilot, not a theft/hardware classifier
evaluation: No training or train/test split. All sources remain in one incident group; compromise and hardware labels remain unknown.
coverage_policy: Features require complete stable provider history and matching payment block anchor. Retain failures without replacement; incomplete history must not produce zero-valued features.
publication: Commit prefix-only normalized evidence, feature rows, aggregate results and raw snapshot hashes. Keep full address histories locally under ignored raw/; hashed identifiers are references, not a guarantee of anonymity.
